whistleblowing.title: Whistleblowing & SEAH Reporting
whistleblowing.subtitle: Zero Tolerance Policy
whistleblowing.description: NASHCOP is committed to creating and maintaining a safe environment free from Sexual Exploitation, Abuse, and Harassment (SEAH). Report concerns confidentially and safely.

sexual_abuse.description: Actual or threatened physical intrusion of a sexual nature, whether by force or under unequal or coercive conditions
examples: Threatening a colleague or beneficiary with sexual acts
Any sexual activity with a child

sexual_harassment.description: Unwelcome conduct of a sexual nature that might reasonably cause offense or humiliation
examples: Displaying or sending unsolicited sexual images
Unwanted comments on appearance by healthcare workers

slide1.title: Welcome to the NASHCoP offices located under the Ministry of Health, in Dodoma Region, Tanzania.
slide1.subtitle: NATIONAL AIDS, STIs AND HEPATITIS CONTROL PROGRAMME
slide1.description: These offices serve as the hub for the national coordination of plans and interventions to prevent, control, and reduce HIV and AIDS infections in the country alongside STIs and Hepatitis. Within this building, we coordinate policies, strategies, and program implementation in collaboration with government institutions, development partners, civil society organizations, and the community. We welcome all visitors and stakeholders to collaborate with us in strengthening national efforts to combat HIV, STIs & Hepatitis to improve the health and well-being of Tanzanians.

slide2.title: Preparation of the Second Phase of the HIV, STIs, and Hepatitis Strategic Plan Concludes
slide2.subtitle: Tanzania: 91% - 99% - 98%
slide2.description: The Ministry of Health, through NASHCoP in collaboration with various stakeholders, today on 23/01/2026 in Morogoro Region, has concluded the first phase of the Preparatory Workshop for the Second Health Sector Strategic Plan for HIV, STIs, and Hepatitis (2027-2031), which will be the main strategy for controlling these diseases. This first working meeting brought together stakeholders to conduct a thorough analysis of the implementation status of the First Strategic Plan.

slide3.title: Universal Health Insurance Brings Justice and Equity in Health Services - Minister Mchengerwa
slide3.subtitle: HIV, STIs and Hepatitis
slide3.description: The Minister of Health, Hon. Mohamed Mchengerwa, on January 23, 2026, stated that the historic launch of universal health insurance will transform the concept of the right to health services in Tanzania and establish a new foundation for health protection in the country. Minister Mchengerwa made these remarks during a working meeting to discuss the implementation of the universal health insurance plan in Dodoma.

slide4.title: Tanzania and the United States Sign a $3.14 Billion MOU to Strengthen the Health Sector
slide4.subtitle: Five-Year Partnership 2026–2030
slide4.description: The Government of Tanzania and the Government of the United States have signed a five-year Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Health Sector Cooperation to be implemented from 2026 to 2030, valued at over USD 3.14 billion through joint investment by both parties.

welcome_message.title: Welcome to NASHCOP Tanzania Official Website
welcome_message.message: Welcome all, to the Tanzanian National AIDS, STIs and Hepatitis Control Programme (NASHCOP) official website. The website is a platform for enhancing everyone's access to information on HIV, AIDS, STIs and Hepatitis, generated in Tanzania. This website aims on sharing HIV, AIDS, STI and Hepatitis information and materials to the general public within and outside the country.
welcome_message.author: Programme Manager - NASHCOP
